\chapopen{१}

\parstart{१.१}{एक बार एक किसान अपने खेत}
\parnum{१.१}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{एक बार}{ek bār}{\dw{बार}{bār} f. time, occasion}{once}
\ch{}{एक किसान}{ek kisān}{\dw{किसान}{kisān} m. farmer}{a farmer}
\ch{}{अपने खेत में}{apne khet meṁ}{\dw{अपना}{apnā} one's own, oblique \pw{अपने}; \dw{खेत}{khet} m. field; \pw{में} in}{in his field}
\ch{}{काम कर रहा था।}{kām kar rahā thā}{\vb{करना}{karnā}{कर}{kar}{किया}{kiyā}{(+\pw{ने})}\bw{काम}{kām}{m. work}; \pw{रहा था} was, the continuous}{was working.}
\end{frank}

\parnum{१.२}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{उसे मिट्टी में}{use miṭṭī meṁ}{\pw{उसे} to him (\pw{उस} \nobreak+\,\pw{को}); \dw{मिट्टी}{miṭṭī} f. earth, soil}{in the soil he}
\ch{}{एक पुरानी अँगूठी मिली।}{ek purānī aṁgūṭhī milī}{\dw{पुराना}{purānā} old, f. \pw{पुरानी}; \dw{अँगूठी}{aṁgūṭhī} f. ring; \vb{मिलना}{milnā}{मिल}{mil}{मिला}{milā}{to be found}, whose finder stands in the dative}{found an old ring.}
\ch{}{उसने उसे उठाया}{usne use uṭhāyā}{\pw{उसने} he, the ergative before a perfective; \vb{उठाना}{uṭhānā}{उठा}{uṭhā}{उठाया}{uṭhāyā}{to pick up (+\pw{ने})}}{he picked it up}
\ch{}{और जेब में रख लिया।}{aur jeb meṁ rakh liyā}{\dw{जेब}{jeb} f. pocket; \vb{रखना}{rakhnā}{रख}{rakh}{रखा}{rakhā}{to put (+\pw{ने})}, \nobreak+\,\pw{लिया}: the compound says he did it for himself}{and put it in his pocket.}
\end{frank}

\parend

\parstart{१.२}{शाम को वह बाज़ार गया}
\parnum{२.१}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{शाम को}{śām ko}{\dw{शाम}{śām} f. evening, \nobreak+\,\pw{को} at}{in the evening}
\ch{}{वह बाज़ार गया।}{vah bāzār gayā}{\dw{बाज़ार}{bāzār} m. market — Pers.; \vb{जाना}{jānā}{जा}{jā}{गया}{gayā}{to go}}{he went to the market.}
\ch{}{उसने सुनार को}{usne sunār ko}{\dw{सुनार}{sunār} m. goldsmith; \pw{को} marks him as the one shown}{he, to the goldsmith,}
\ch{}{अँगूठी दिखाई।}{aṁgūṭhī dikhāī}{\vb{दिखाना}{dikhānā}{दिखा}{dikhā}{दिखाया}{dikhāyā}{to show (+\pw{ने})}, f. \pw{दिखाई} agreeing with \pw{अँगूठी}}{showed the ring.}
\end{frank}

\parnum{२.२}
\begin{frank}
\ch{}{सुनार ने कहा:}{sunār ne kahā}{\pw{ने} the ergative, which every transitive perfective takes; \vb{कहना}{kahnā}{कह}{kah}{कहा}{kahā}{to say (+\pw{ने})}}{the goldsmith said:}
\ch{}{यह सोने की नहीं,}{yah sone kī nahīṁ}{\dw{सोना}{sonā} m. gold, oblique \pw{सोने}; \pw{की} of, feminine because \pw{अँगूठी} is}{this is not gold,}
\ch{}{पीतल की है।}{pītal kī hai}{\dw{पीतल}{pītal} m. brass}{it is brass.}
\ch{}{किसान हँसा और बोला:}{kisān haṁsā aur bolā}{\vb{हँसना}{haṁsnā}{हँस}{haṁs}{हँसा}{haṁsā}{to laugh}; \vb{बोलना}{bolnā}{बोल}{bol}{बोला}{bolā}{to speak (±\pw{ने})}; \pw{हँसना} never takes \pw{ने} and \pw{बोलना} takes it only with an object, so \pw{किसान} has none here}{the farmer laughed and said:}
\ch{}{फिर भी यह मेरी है।}{phir bhī yah merī hai}{\pw{फिर भी} even so; \dw{मेरा}{merā} my, f. \pw{मेरी}}{even so it is mine.}
\end{frank}

\chapend
